name: foodfacts-app
description: Full-stack Open Food Facts product explorer with i18n and Stripe-gated nutrition data

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix backend run prisma:deploy && npm --prefix backend run seed
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
